senses.definition: n.[m.] drop, dripping (NH id.; on form (if genuine) cf. NöM 85, NS 191)—ψ 72:6 כִּרְבִיבִים ז׳ אָ֑רֶץ as showers, a dripping of the earth, but v. foregoing.
